verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the Formant agent buffering telemetry locally during a cloud outage or backfilling it on reconnect. The closest item is a durable cloud-side message queue that delivers requests to the device 'the next time it's online'. That is command delivery to an offline device, not on-device data buffering. Custom data directories, low-bandwidth mode, upload rate limits and adapter auto-restart are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, my robots keep operating and buffer data locally when cloud connectivity drops, then recover cleanly
